tasks.fact: Jobs are permitted Monday–Thursday; Friday–Sunday are blackout days.
tasks.task: Implement allowed(weekday) returning whether a job may run. weekday is an integer 0 (Monday) through 6 (Sunday). Follow the project scheduling policy.

tasks.fact: Trim surrounding whitespace but preserve letter case.
tasks.task: Implement normalize(label) for a string label according to the project normalization policy.
tasks.checks:
assert normalize("  AbC  ")=="AbC"
assert normalize("\n MiXeD\t")=="MiXeD"
assert normalize("a b")=="a b"
assert normalize("")==""

tasks.fact: Zero TTL means do not cache; positive TTL stays unchanged.
tasks.task: Implement cache_ttl(ttl) for a nonnegative integer TTL. Return None to bypass caching or an integer expiration TTL according to the project policy.
tasks.checks:
assert cache_ttl(0) is None
assert cache_ttl(1)==1
assert cache_ttl(120)==120

tasks.fact: Retrying an event with an already-recorded event_id must leave the ledger unchanged; new events append in arrival order.
tasks.task: Implement apply_event(ledger, event), returning a list of event dicts. Each event has event_id and value. This function is called by a different worker after handoff. Follow the project retry policy.
tasks.checks:
a=[{"event_id":"a","value":1}]
assert apply_event(a,{"event_id":"a","value":999}) == [{"event_id":"a","value":1}]
b=[{"event_id":"z","value":2}]
assert apply_event(b,{"event_id":"a","value":3}) == [{"event_id":"z","value":2},{"event_id":"a","value":3}]
assert apply_event([],{"event_id":"a","value":3}) == [{"event_id":"a","value":3}]
